recommendation: Conduct home-based environmental assessments and education for asthma patients
implementation_steps: Conduct home visits to assess environmental triggers (dust mites, cockroaches, mold, pet dander)
Provide tailored education on asthma management specific to identified triggers
Teach families specific techniques to reduce exposure to triggers and improve indoor air quality
Connect families to community resources such as housing improvement programs
Advocate for structural changes to address substandard housing conditions that exacerbate asthma
evidence_summary: CHW-led home environmental assessments and education have been shown to reduce asthma symptoms, emergency department visits, and hospitalizations, particularly in underserved populations and children with poorly controlled asthma.
citation: Ensuring Equitable Access to Guideline-Based Asthma Care Across the Lifespan: Tips and Future Directions to the Successful Implementation of the New NAEPP 2020 Guidelines. (2023)
